title: Probe (test-only): Analytic R_vp vs β on baseline PG (no RIN) — 4‑step LN‑ConvLSTM(64)
abstract: Test-only probe computing the init trunk gradient ratio R_vp = ||∇_trunk L_value|| / ||∇_trunk L_policy|| for the baseline PG agent (no RIN). Reports analytic R_vp(β)=β·R_vp for β∈{1.0,1.2,1.5} since scaling only trunk value-gradients multiplies the trunk value L2 norm linearly. Avoids treedef issues.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/zephyr')
from typing import Dict, Any
import jax, jax.numpy as jnp
import numpy as np
from flax.core import unfreeze
from flax import traverse_util

from submissions.submission_pg_quadstep import PG_Stepped_AttnGap
from defaults import default_calculate_gae

BASE_SEED = 42

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {}

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    return PG_Stepped_AttnGap(
        cnn_features_1=32, cnn_features_2=64,
        convlstm_features=64, dilation=6,
        bottleneck_ratio=0.28, head_hidden=64, steps=4,
    )

def _build_trunk_mask_from_paths(params_tree):
    # Mark Conv/ConvLSTM/Bottleneck params as trunk; Dense as heads.
    flat = traverse_util.flatten_dict(unfreeze(params_tree))
    mask_flat = {}
    for k in flat.keys():
        path = "/".join(k)
        is_trunk = ("ConvLSTM" in path) or ("Bottleneck" in path) or ("Conv_" in path)
        mask_flat[k] = bool(is_trunk)
    return mask_flat  # keep flat mask; no tree ops needed

def _tree_l2norm_where_flat(grad_params, mask_flat, want_trunk=True):
    gflat = traverse_util.flatten_dict(unfreeze(grad_params))
    s2 = 0.0
    for k, g in gflat.items():
        if g is None:
            continue
        is_trunk = mask_flat.get(k, False)
        if bool(is_trunk) == bool(want_trunk):
            s2 += float(jnp.vdot(g, g))
    return float(np.sqrt(s2))

def test():
    print("=== INIT ANALYTIC R_vp(β) PROBE: BASELINE (no RIN) ===")
    key = jax.random.PRNGKey(BASE_SEED)
    net = create_network({})

    # Init params
    obs_dummy = jnp.zeros((1,8,8,8), dtype=jnp.float32)
    done_dummy = jnp.zeros((1,), dtype=bool)
    params = net.init(key, obs_dummy, done_dummy, None)

    # Synthetic batch (B,T)
    B, T = 8, 20
    key, k1, k2 = jax.random.split(key, 3)
    observations = jax.random.normal(k1, (B,T,8,8,8), dtype=jnp.float32)
    actions = jax.random.randint(k2, (B,T), 0, 4)
    dones = jnp.zeros((B,T), dtype=bool)
    obs_flat = observations.reshape(B*T, 8, 8, 8)
    dones_flat = dones.reshape(B*T)

    # Forward to get values
    logits_flat, values_flat, _ = net.apply(params, obs_flat, dones_flat, None)
    all_logits = logits_flat.reshape(B,T,-1)
    all_values = values_flat.reshape(B,T)
    final_values = all_values[:, -1]

    # Zero rewards; use model values in GAE
    rewards = jnp.zeros((B,T), dtype=jnp.float32)
    advantages = default_calculate_gae(rewards, all_values, dones, gamma=0.97, gae_lambda=0.97, next_values=final_values)
    returns = advantages + all_values

    def loss_pi_ent(p):
        l = net.apply(p, obs_flat, dones_flat, None)[0].reshape(B,T,-1)
        log_probs_all = jax.nn.log_softmax(l, axis=-1)
        idx = (jnp.arange(B)[:,None], jnp.arange(T), actions)
        logp = log_probs_all[idx]
        L_pi = -jnp.mean(jax.lax.stop_gradient(advantages) * logp)
        probs = jax.nn.softmax(l, axis=-1)
        entropy = -jnp.mean(jnp.sum(probs * log_probs_all, axis=-1))
        return L_pi - 0.01 * entropy

    def loss_v_only(p):
        v = net.apply(p, obs_flat, dones_flat, None)[1].reshape(B,T)
        return 0.5 * jnp.mean((v - jax.lax.stop_gradient(returns)) ** 2)

    g_pi = jax.grad(loss_pi_ent)(params)
    g_v  = jax.grad(loss_v_only)(params)

    mask_flat = _build_trunk_mask_from_paths(params["params"])
    trunk_pi = _tree_l2norm_where_flat(g_pi["params"], mask_flat, True)
    trunk_v  = _tree_l2norm_where_flat(g_v["params"],  mask_flat, True)
    R_base = trunk_v / max(trunk_pi, 1e-8)
    trunk_leaves = sum(1 for v in mask_flat.values() if v)
    head_leaves  = sum(1 for v in mask_flat.values() if not v)
    print(f"Baseline: R_vp={R_base:.4f}  [||g_v,trunk||={trunk_v:.4f}, ||g_pi,trunk||={trunk_pi:.4f}]  leaves(trunk/head)={trunk_leaves}/{head_leaves}")

    for beta in [1.0, 1.2, 1.5]:
        R_beta = beta * R_base  # linear scaling on trunk value L2 norm
        print(f"β={beta:.2f} → analytic R_vp(β) = {R_beta:.4f}")

    print("Probe complete.")
    return "OK"
